name: Zephyr Renesas RA8D1-EK
description: The Zephyr RTOS is a open source, highly configurable, scalable, secure, modular and vendor neutral real time operating system. The EK-RA8D1 evaluation kit enables users to effortlessly evaluate the features of the RA8D1 MCU Group and develop embedded systems applications using Renesas’ Flexible Software Package (FSP) and e2 studio IDE. Utilize rich on-board features along with your choice of popular ecosystem add-ons to bring your big ideas to life.  The MCU has a Cortex-M85 core which utilizes the Helium (SIMD) instruction set of Arm. Besides that the chip is equipped with a GPU (called DAVE2D) to off load the MCU.
shortDescription: Zephyr RTOS project for Renesas EK-RA8D1 with LVGL
getStartedInstructions:
1. Install the Zephyr prerequisites, west and the Zephyr SDK: `https://docs.zephyrproject.org/latest/develop/getting_started/index.html`.
2. From the folder that contains this project run `west init -l lv_zephyr` and `west update`.
3. Enter the project folder: `cd lv_zephyr`.
4. Build: `west build -p -b ek_ra8d1 --shield rtkmipilcdb00000be`.
5. Run `west flash` for flashing and `west debug` for debugging.
